discovery_notes: Follow-up 1 to packet 206 (B006, Disney Store 2019); reuses 206 keys. 30 standard WebSearches, excluded domains blocked, snippets only. Filled Wisdom Feb/May-Dec members (3-pin packs, each pin described), new Aug Bambi set, Up 10th LE 2400 set (US/UK), Dumbo live-action LR set, Bambi jumbo LE400 (held on year), UK/EU prices and codes for LK 25th, LK jumbo, Aladdin LR. Holds added on conflicting third pins (Aug Thumper/Flower, Dec Gus/Jaq). No holds existed in 206 to release. Mickey 90th wrap-up not researched.
